# OpenZeppelin Contracts 5.3.0 — `utils/Base64.sol`

A byte-identical copy of `@openzeppelin/contracts@5.3.0/utils/Base64.sol` (sha256
`c3738c1be3c48c5f78e311119a74256f2df0336951369b1d8290838459f8b4a1`), served to the one import that
reaches it — `openzeppelin-contracts/contracts/utils/Base64.sol`, used by `GianoSmartWallet` and
webauthn-sol — by the first line of `remappings.txt`.

Why it exists: the wallet's CREATE2 addresses (`CANONICAL_FACTORY`, `CANONICAL_IMPLEMENTATION` in
`canonical.ts`) depend on its bytecode, and solc embeds a hash of every source file in that bytecode.
OpenZeppelin 5.4.0 (taken for GHSA-9rcw-c2f9-2j55, which is in `Bytes.sol`, not here) changed this
file only cosmetically (header comment and loop formatting), yet that alone would move every account
address. Pinning the file keeps the frozen wallet build reproducible while the rest of OpenZeppelin
moves on.

Do not edit this file. Dropping the pin is a new canonical freeze of the wallet; see `canonical.ts`.
